review: 701.2a-2: the opponent_hand variant changed two facts (Sandbar moved to B's hand and a Plains moved to A's); removed the irrelevant Plains so the variant moves only Lonely Sandbar, and gave A a library card for cycling to draw.

scenarios.title: Only the controller of an object can activate its activated ability
decisions: A has priority in main phase 1 with an empty stack and considers activating Prodigal Sorcerer's ability ({T}: 1 damage to any target).

variants.label: controller_has_priority
variants.expected: A controls Prodigal Sorcerer and has priority, so the activation is legal (can_play true).

variants.label: opponent_controls
variants.delta: Prodigal Sorcerer is on B's battlefield instead and A considers activating it.
variants.expected: A does not control Prodigal Sorcerer, so A cannot activate its ability (can_play false).

scenarios.title: A card with no controller can be activated by its owner
decisions: A has priority in main phase 1 with an empty stack and considers activating the cycling ability ({U}, discard) of Lonely Sandbar, paying with Island.

variants.label: owner_hand
variants.expected: Lonely Sandbar is in A's hand, so A, its owner, can activate its cycling: the activation is legal (can_play true).

variants.label: opponent_hand
variants.delta: Lonely Sandbar is in B's hand instead of A's.
variants.expected: A neither controls nor owns Lonely Sandbar, so A cannot activate its cycling (can_play false).

scenarios.title: An object can say that any player may activate its ability

setup.notes: B has priority with an empty stack after A passes in main phase 1; Flailing Soldier is controlled by A.

decisions: A passes priority in main phase 1; B receives priority and considers activating Flailing Soldier's ability ({1}: +1/+1 until end of turn), paying with Mountain.

variants.label: any_player_may_activate
variants.expected: Flailing Soldier says any player may activate its abilities, so B, who does not control it, can activate it: legal (can_play true).

variants.label: controller_only
variants.delta: A's creature is Prodigal Sorcerer instead (ready to tap), and B considers activating its ability.
variants.expected: Prodigal Sorcerer does not say another player may activate it, so B cannot activate it (can_play false).
